page_title: HOL 1-0 HEI | Holstein Kiel v Heidenheim 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+1' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Total attempts – 11:14.
85' Substitution. Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) has come on for Marvin Pieringer.
85' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) replaces Paul Wanner.
85' Substitution. Phil Harres will be replaced by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel).
84' A yellow card for a tackle by Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel). Frank Willenborg doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
82' The resulting set piece from Holstein Kiel is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

81' Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Holstein Kiel are awarded a corner kick.
81' The attendance for today's match is 14000.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) coming on for Tymoteusz Puchacz.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) for Steven Skrzybski.
76' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
74' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Niklas Dorsch and he is replaced by Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim).
74' It will be a substitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Benedikt Gimber walks off.

72' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
70' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) picked up a yellow card from referee.
67' The main referee, Frank Willenborg, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) is given a yellow card for dissent.
67' PENALTY APPEAL after Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
66' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
64' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
63' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Heidenheim earn a corner.
59' The foul by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Frank Willenborg.
56' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
53' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

49' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
48' It's a free kick to Heidenheim in a dangerous position.
46' The game is over for Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim). Mathias Honsak comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) will not participate anymore and Finn Porath is coming on.
46' Marcel Rapp has made a change at the break. Lasse Rosenboom has come on in place of Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Heidenheim! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Frank Willenborg and both teams have no complaints.

45+3' There's a break in play and referee Frank Willenborg must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Heidenheim using VAR. This could be interesting!
45+2' Dangerous play by Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel). Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Heidenheim.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' The game is interrupted now, Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' The corner from Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is hurriedly cleared.
41' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
39' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Timon Weiner has no trouble gathering it.
38' Today's referee Frank Willenborg rightly decides to book Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) for his harsh tackle.
38' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) sends a cross into the box, but Kevin Muller comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) receives a yellow card for infringement.
35' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
33' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) sees a yellow card from Frank Willenborg after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
32' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Timon Weiner sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Surely that's handball by one of the Holstein Kiel players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
30' Holstein Kiel are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

28' 1 - 0 Goal! Max Geschwill peels away from his marker to connect with the resulting free kick and heads the ball towards Patrick Erras (Holstein Kiel), who does brilliantly to nod the ball into the net. He makes it 1:0.
24' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Timon Weiner and he's equal to it.

23' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
21' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
20' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

19' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Kevin Muller was alert and made a comfortable save. Holstein Kiel have a corner.
19' The corner from Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) is cleared away by the defence.
19' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Holstein Kiel have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Frank Willenborg shows the yellow card to Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) for a heavy challenge.
12' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
11' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

9' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
8' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

8' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the right side of the goal, but Timon Weiner pulls off a great save to deny him. Corner kick. Heidenheim will have an opportunity.
7' Phil Harres (Holstein Kiel) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' Patrick Erras (Holstein Kiel) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
3' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Holstein Kiel will kick the game off.
Frank Willenborg is introduced as the referee for today's match.
